WITH store_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk 
    FROM store_sales 
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
web_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk 
    FROM web_sales 
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
catalog_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk 
    FROM catalog_sales 
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
)
SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) cnt3 
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN store_sales_filtered ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales_filtered ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales_filtered cs ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_ship_customer_sk
WHERE ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
